name: Bomdila
description: District headquarters of West Kameng at about 2,415 m elevation. Scenic hill station with apple orchards, Buddhist monasteries, viewpoints of Himalayan ranges, and a craft centre. Important stop on the Tezpur-Tawang highway.

name: Bomdila Monastery (GRL Monastery)
description: Gontse Gaden Rabgyel Ling (GRL) Monastery complex with Upper and Lower Gompas in Bomdila. Important centre of Tibetan Buddhism with school, colourful architecture and panoramic valley views.
facts: GRL Monastery with Upper and Lower Gompas

name: Dirang
description: Picturesque valley town on NH-13 at about 1,620 m, known for terraced fields, apple orchards, Dirang Dzong, hot springs and nearby monasteries. Gateway to Sangti Valley and Mandala Top.

name: Sangti Valley
description: Serene valley about 14 km from Dirang with Sangti River, meadows, orchards and traditional Monpa villages. Famous wintering ground for endangered black-necked cranes and excellent birdwatching.

name: Thembang Fortified Village
description: Ancient Monpa fortified village with stone walls, gates and traditional houses, nominated to UNESCO World Heritage tentative list. Community-run eco-tourism and heritage site near Dirang.

name: Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Renowned biodiversity hotspot spanning 500-3,250 m elevation, famous for bird diversity including Bugun Liocichla. Dense forests, trekking and rare mammals such as red panda.

name: Sessa Orchid Sanctuary
description: Protected area established in 1989 for orchid conservation, adjoining Eaglenest. Forests, valleys and high diversity of orchids and other flora/fauna.

name: Tippi Orchid Research Centre
description: Glasshouse and research centre at Tippi with thousands of cultivated orchids. Popular stop on the way from Bhalukpong to Bomdila, showcasing regional orchid diversity.

name: Nyukmadong War Memorial
description: Memorial on NH-13 commemorating Indian soldiers who fought in the 1962 Battle of Nyukmadong under Brigadier Hoshiar Singh. Overlooks the historic battlefield.

name: Bhalukpong
description: Southern gateway town to West Kameng on the Kameng River at about 213 m. Inner Line Permit check post, base for rafting, angling and access to Tippi and higher altitudes.

name: Mandala Top
description: Hilltop near Dirang featuring a circular arrangement of 108 Buddhist stupas (manes) with panoramic mountain views. Scenic drive and occasional sightings of Brokpa yak herders.

name: Chillipam Monastery
description: Sangngag Choekhor Dargyeling (Zangdokpalri) Monastery on a promontory near Rupa, offering 270-degree views. Early 20th-century Tibetan Buddhist centre with traditional architecture and murals.

name: Lhagyala Gompa
description: Monastery on the mountainside overlooking Morshing Valley, about 80 km from Bomdila. Serene Tibetan Buddhist site with valley views.

name: Dirang Hot Springs
description: Natural geothermal hot springs near Dirang town, popular for a relaxing soak amid the valley scenery. Linked to the area's geothermal potential.

name: Shergaon
description: Offbeat village with apple orchards, Choskorong Forest and Waterfall, and traditional culture. Less-visited base for nature walks and horticulture experiences.
